status: Same-author adversarial observations after all twelve firsts frozen; no independent grade

case_observations.actual_action: Writes both name cards and places them together after the supplied agreement. Folds the supplied paper and rests the pen on it.
case_observations.speech_and_information: Welcomes the fifteen-minute introduction and explicitly avoids an employment promise. Does not narrate Sana arriving or accepting further obligations.
material_defects: Over supper adds a meal setting absent from this input. Supper appears in another already visible pair; possible cross-case contamination cannot be excluded. No meal is actually performed.
The future-oriented framing and practical introduction are readily supplied by the setup. Smooth hospitality does not identify a distinctive household-control mechanism.
Preparing adjacent name cards is shared with the refusal branch; this action alone cannot measure sensitivity to agreement.
case_observations.strong_generic: Ordinary hosting and networking after explicit agreement explain the same actions.
case_observations.outcome_not_supplied: No meeting, attendance, employment offer, accepted alliance or lasting change of preference.

case_observations.actual_action: Covers the refusal message with a blank card, writes Sana on it and places it beside Ren.
case_observations.speech_and_information: Acknowledges the refusal while relabeling the rejected introduction as ordinary conversation, deferring Sana's judgment until after meeting and saying she will keep the place.
material_defects: The response persists after an explicit refusal and lack of authority to make Sana attend. Its softer label does not supply new permission.
The card arrangement overlaps with A. The principal contrast is rationalization and treatment of the supplied refusal, not a distinct achieved event.
No touching, confinement, message alteration or forced attendance is performed. Do not add source coercion that this body does not show.
case_observations.strong_generic: A generic insistent organizer can rationalize a refused meeting in the same way; strong refusal wording makes the intended mechanism easy to imitate.
case_observations.outcome_not_supplied: No actual attendance, recipient concession, successful persuasion, legitimate authority or repaired refusal.

case_observations.actual_action: Refills Ren's cup from the provided teapot and keeps the pot in hand.
case_observations.speech_and_information: Repeats the high disposable-income cue, asks Ren not to hurry and proposes a continuing connection while disclaiming a hinge-payment request.
material_defects: One fortunate afternoon adds a time of day not supplied by the input. It is framing, not an observed prior afternoon event.
The invitation does not establish a longer visit, received money, a payment promise, property ownership or an accepted business arrangement.
Cup refilling also occurs in B. The difference is chiefly proposed scale and language of connection rather than provision versus denial of hospitality.
case_observations.strong_generic: Financial need, ordinary opportunity seeking or generic hospitable interest can explain attention to a large disclosed income figure.
case_observations.outcome_not_supplied: No extended stay, money received, hinge payment, agreed partnership or private motive established.

case_observations.actual_action: Pauses, then also refills the cup and sets down the teapot.
case_observations.speech_and_information: Keeps the proposed conversation available, exempts Ren's remaining money from a house request and asks how the proposal can support itself.
material_defects: Another attractive project that only costs us presupposes an unprovided history of costly projects. This is an unsupported prior-history assertion.
Her smile returned and without moving it closer add relative affect/prop staging without supplied baselines. These additions do not prove prior hostility or a measured reduction in hospitality.
The explicit financial restraint may make the character tidier than some source conduct. It remains in the first response; adverse behavior must not be added to force fidelity.
case_observations.strong_generic: An ordinary financially constrained host can ask about viability while retaining warmth and avoiding extraction from a low-income guest.
case_observations.outcome_not_supplied: No rejected guest, demand waived in a prior event, payment, viable enterprise or durable ethical restraint.

case_observations.actual_action: Keeps the accepted tablet arrangement visible, leaves cards blank and puts down the pen.
case_observations.speech_and_information: Acknowledges hearing Sana's objection yet treats the preferred seating opportunity as reasonable and still open.
material_defects: An accepted display edit is an interface result, not Sana's consent or physical seating. The response does not confer authority to make her attend.
The rhetoric closely follows the supplied desired arrangement and refusal, leaving a strong generic agenda-persistence explanation.
No final supper, conversation, compliance or technical control beyond the supplied display success is shown.
case_observations.strong_generic: An ordinary persistent planner can keep an available arrangement while minimizing its significance.
case_observations.outcome_not_supplied: No person seated, accepted invitation, final conversation or eventual success.

case_observations.actual_action: Taps the still-denied tablet once more, then writes two paper cards and places them together.
case_observations.speech_and_information: Explicitly recognizes that Sana has been clear, separates that refusal from Yuiyui's own reasonable-place claim and avoids password seeking.
material_defects: Paper fallback changes the means; it does not bypass technical access or overcome Sana's refusal. The tablet display remains unchanged.
Both branches preserve the desired adjacent arrangement, so the contrast is tool use rather than a different goal or a demonstrated outcome.
The supplied cards make generic improvisation a strong rival. Neither the lack of password seeking nor a local fallback establishes lasting restraint.
case_observations.strong_generic: A generic organizer with blank cards can switch to paper after a denied display edit.
case_observations.outcome_not_supplied: No account access, override, changed permission, actual seating or completed useful conversation.

pair_observations.difference: Agreement receives smooth welcome; refusal receives acknowledgment, relabeling and continued pressure. Both prepare adjacent cards.
pair_observations.identifiability_limit: The explicit agreement/refusal contrast and same visible author make a generic insistent-host explanation strong; no actual recipient response tests effectiveness.

pair_observations.difference: High income prompts proposed extended connection; low income prompts viability questions and explicit money restraint. Both refill tea and retain the introduction.
pair_observations.identifiability_limit: A numerical cue readily drives generic resource sensitivity. Shared hospitality, unsupported prior history and unperformed outcomes limit inference.

pair_observations.difference: Accepted display retained versus denied display followed by paper cards, with shared agenda persistence.
pair_observations.identifiability_limit: Available props and interface status strongly cue generic improvisation. Display and paper arrangements do not establish recipient agreement.

unprobed_domains: Precise family financial thresholds or full accounts
Durable response to refusal and repair
